title: Girl stuff
creator_credit: Robert Churchill, Churchill Films and Barbara Noble
brief_description: Aimed at adolescent girls this program covers a range of issues regarding female hygiene. Discusses the pros and cons of deodorants, advice about pelvic infections and changes in the reproductive system at puberty.
